source_rule_assertions.source_rule_assertion: Barbarian as a multiclass entry grants Martial weapons and Shields
Barbarian as a multiclass entry grants no saving throws or Simple weapons
Monk (level 1) is proficient with Martial weapons only if they have the Light property
Monk (level 1) Martial proficiency with a Heavy-only weapon is not granted
Wizard has no Expertise grant (only Scholar's one listed skill)
Barbarian Weapon Mastery counts only Melee weapons
Barbarian Weapon Mastery is 2 kinds at level 3 and 4 at level 10
Paladin Weapon Mastery requires proficiency with the weapon
Soldier chooses exactly one kind of Gaming Set
All six saving throws only through Disciplined Survivor (level 14)
College of Lore's three skills need the College of Lore subclass at Bard level 3
Grappler's +1 needs level 4 and Strength or Dexterity 13
